description: Side-by-side comparison meme of two circular flag logos. Left: the red 1932-era German Antifaschistische Aktion emblem, captioned as the '1933 Paramilitary Wing of the Communist Party of Germany'. Right: the modern red-and-black Antifascist Action (antifa) emblem on black, captioned as the '2017 Paramilitary Wing of the Democratic Party of America'. The captions claim a lineage and party affiliation for the two logos.
text: 1933 Paramilitary Wing of the Communist Party of Germany. ANTIFASCHISTISCHE AKTION. 2017 Paramilitary Wing of the Democratic Party of America. ANTIFASCIST ACTION
flags: Captions' characterization of antifa as the Democratic Party's 'paramilitary wing' is the meme's claim, unsupported; antifa has no formal party affiliation
